supplements.about: Curated by Tessera. Lists APIs whose official documentation states that they serve generative AI models (LLMs, multimodal, image or video generation) behind an API key. Each entry was checked against the official docs page linked here on the date shown. Pricing and free tiers were not verified and are shown as Unknown. The upstream public-apis catalog has no AI Models category, so upstream listings keep their own category and are only cross-tagged.
